title: The zones' gimmicks: res/field/zone_gimmicks/zone_gimmicks.json
description: ARCID_GIMMICK_TBL (a/1/0/2): the zones that have a gimmick, a ZoneGimmick each (event_mapchange.c), which GameData_SetGimmickByZone searches when the player enters a zone. tools/data/zone_gimmick_data.py packs it.

zones.description: The zones, searched in order; a zone that isn't here has no gimmick

gimmick.description: The gimmick, its number in GIMMICK_OVERLAY_INFO (field_gimmick.c), which gives its overlay and its init, end and update functions: 2 to 7, 9, 10, 37 and 38 the gyms, 12 the gates' news boards (gate_boards/), 16 to 24 and 31 the Battle Subway, and so on
